source.title: JRC Reference Data from Experiments on Onboard Hydrogen Tanks Fast Filling
source.article_license: CC BY 3.0 (article record; raw trace reuse terms not established)

access_observation.observation: The current JRC record exposes bibliographic metadata and paper links, but no dataset identifier, download URL, or raw pressure-temperature-time files.

reason: The record concerns onboard-tank experiments rather than a synchronized station-controller-vehicle fueling trace, and no machine-readable data archive or raw-trace reuse terms are linked from the official record.
claim_boundary: This recheck is provenance/access evidence only. It does not add a numerical validation case, permit figure digitization as primary validation, or change frozen model outcomes.
next_action: Use research/JRC_GASTEF_DATA_REQUEST_DRAFT.md to request a de-identified GasTeF/HYTRANSFER trace export, channel dictionary, calibration metadata, and written permission for derived metrics and IJHE publication before outcome access.
